connections.title: Connections
connections.description: The Ollama servers used to chat, on this computer or remote.
connections.emptyText: Add Ollama on this computer or on a remote server to start chatting.

delete.title: Delete this connection?
delete.message: “{name}” will be removed. Your conversations are not affected.

step1.question: Where does your model run?
step1.remoteText: A PC or server reachable through your WireGuard VPN or your local network.

form.localHint: No setup needed: we look for Ollama on the default port.

host.label: IP address or machine name
host.help: Its address inside the WireGuard tunnel. Port 11434 is added automatically.

test.searchingLocal: Looking for Ollama on this computer…
test.helpLocal: Start Ollama and try again. You can also add the connection now and start it later.
test.helpCustom: Check the address and that the server is running.

advanced.autoHelp: Lists the installed models each time the picker is opened.
advanced.manualDuplicate: This model is already in the list.
advanced.shutdownHelp: Shows a “Shut down” button in the sidebar.
advanced.shutdownUrlInvalid: The listener URL must start with http:// or https://.

shutdown.title: Remote shutdown
shutdown.description: The “Shut down” button in the sidebar sends an HTTP request to a small program running on the remote machine. You need that program's URL and its secret token.
shutdown.urlInvalid: The URL must start with http:// or https://.
shutdown.tokenCleared: The token will be cleared on save.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose the color theme and the interface language.
appearance.hint: The theme and language are saved on this device.

wireguard.title: WireGuard guide
wireguard.description: Use Ollama on another machine, through a VPN tunnel.

step1.title: Install WireGuard
step1.before: On this PC and on the server, from

step2.title: Create the tunnel
step2.text: Import or create the tunnel in the official client, then bring it up on both sides.

step3.title: Make Ollama reachable through the tunnel
step3.text: On the server, set the environment variable below, then restart Ollama.
step3.firewallAfter: in the firewall, for the WireGuard interface only.

step4.title: Add the connection here
step4.text: In the Connections section, click “Add a connection” and choose “On another machine”. Enter the server's IP inside the tunnel, for example:
step4.done: The connection test starts on its own: the detected models are listed if everything works.

wireguard.security: Never expose port 11434 to the Internet without a VPN: Ollama has no authentication.
